name: io.github.douglasdemaio/vtessera
description: Find vtessera agent offers, read agent cards, route an intent, and read signed attestations.

packageArguments.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read

environmentVariables.name: VTESSERA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

vtessera/draft.why: The hosted endpoint is real and verified: https://vtessera-mcp.fly.dev/mcp initializes and serves all seven read-only tools against the live marketplace. The remaining gap before submission is the container image: the identifier names ghcr.io/douglasdemaio/vtessera-mcp:0.1.0, and publishing it is a deploy decision.
blockers: packages[0].identifier is an OCI reference. The registry has no binary package type for a Go program, so the listing names a container image. Publishing it is `make mcp-image-push`, which needs a gh token carrying write:packages.
packages[0].identifier and version must name an image that exists before submission, or the listing advertises a package nobody can pull.
Submitting also needs a GitHub OAuth token with repo scope, which is the publisher's to hold.
beforeSubmitting: Set version here to the same string as mcpserver.Version, which is what a client sees at initialize. A listing and a binary that disagree is worse than either alone.
Set fileSha256 if the digest is known.
vtessera/draft.schemaCheckedIn: server.schema.json is the published 2025-12-11 schema, fetched and stored so this file is validated without a network call.
